access_evidence: GET https://api.sam.gov/ and GET /entity-information/v2/entities?api_key=test&samRegistered=Yes both returned HTTP 404 with a ZERO-byte body. The documented route (https://open.gsa.gov/api/sam-entity-extracts-api/, HTTP 200, 42,115 B) states: 'To access Public extracts: Users must have a non-Federal/Federal Individual (Personal) account and the respective API Key'.
blockers: UNKEYED_HOST_404: api.sam.gov returns HTTP 404 with an empty body even for its documented paths, so the failure mode is not a 401/403.
licence_note: The GSA docs page states the access requirement ('Users must have a non-Federal/Federal Individual (Personal) account and the respective API Key') but no reuse-licence sentence was found on it. Recorded as publicly readable without an explicit reuse licence.
machine_interface: REST JSON (keyed) + bulk extract files on sam.gov/data-services
name: SAM.gov — System for Award Management entity/exclusions extracts
notes: Not needed for this workstream's findings: SAM UEIs arrive with USAspending awards.
rate_policy: Per the docs page: 'API Key Rate Limits' section; not exercised.
unlock_route: Create a SAM.gov individual (personal) account, request an API key, then use the Entity/Exclusions Extracts API (https://open.gsa.gov/api/sam-entity-extracts-api/) for monthly public extract files.
what_is_new: Nothing collected: access is registration-gated and the unkeyed host returns a zero-byte 404 rather than an auth error. Clean negative.
